research_direction: How much of a two-arm weight difference is content and how much is data-order noise? PR #312 treated d_mid = theta(midtrain_live) - theta(midtrain_clean) as the entire content-attributable difference. The two midtrain runs also differ in data order. Using a second midtrain seed that already existed on disk (reversibility_dose_1b/runs/seed777), the same-content different-seed difference is 2.570/2.582 against a total two-arm difference of 2.830, and cos(d_mid@20260804, d_mid@777) = 0.165. Two estimators put the content component at 1.148 and 1.168 -- 41% of ||d_mid|| by norm, 17% by energy. The corrected content signal-to-noise ratio against the SFT seed spread is 0.52, not the 1.278 reported in #312.
submitted_cells: SFT seed 20260804, four cells trained at peak LR 5e-6 from the same two midtrain checkpoints used by PRs #291/#293/#297/#302.
relationship_to_prior_attempts: Corrects my own #312. Same four trained cells, deliberately -- no new training; the contribution is a measurement over checkpoints that already existed. #312's Result 2 (SNR) is replaced, its Result 1 (preservation) is withdrawn as a claim about content while standing as a claim about the whole difference vector, and its Result 4 (the SFT learning-rate lever) is untouched because that comparison uses bit-identical midtrain checkpoints.

token_matching.note: Both midtrain arms are token-matched by construction (scimt.train.mix.control_mix). The SFT arms are token-matched to within the packing remainder; the exact totals are listed above rather than asserted.

what_still_replicates: The behavioural 2x2 is unchanged from #312: interaction +0.273 rate / +1.118 logit at peak LR 5e-6, +0.440 / +2.220 at 2e-5, n=300 per cell, positive on rate, logit and arcsine at both rates. All four submitted cells verified to have resumed from the shared midtrain pair.
